changes: With MUTE ALL SOUND, a muted pad's hit in LIVE RECORDING reaches the audio block, which drops the muted track's trig before any voice is taken (site 0x40120a66), so RTRG + a muted pad records its whole roll without sounding or stealing a shared voice; a second site at the pad glow store (0x4012155a) lights the pad on each dropped hit.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
